🔄 Content Updated (Published: August 17, 2026 / Previously Posted: August 6, 2026)
Main Changes: New announcements added as of August 17, 2026 — first public disclosure of the secret transmission documents of "Shimona-guri Lion Dance" and announcements regarding corporate version hometown tax contributions from FLATT Co., Ltd., Kouyou-sha, and Yamaguchi-gumi.

The press release materials list on the official Hanno City website has been updated. The main announcements for fiscal year 2026 are as follows:

• First public disclosure of the secret transmission documents passed down in "Shimona-guri Lion Dance" (announced August 17)
• Call for business operators for private management transition accompanying the rebuilding of Asama Childcare Center (announced August 5)
• Appointment of Hanno City PR Ambassadors (announced August 3)
• Conclusion of a forest conservation agreement with The Coca-Cola Company Japan and Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan (announced July 29)
• Hosting of "Hanno Summer Solstice Festival — Forest, Water, and Sun Beer Garden" (announced July 23)

For announcements prior to these, please see the original article.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/hishokohoka/hisho/hodohappyo/houdouhappyou2025_1/13388.html
